Real-time monitoring dashboard ensuring mandatory 2-month investigation completion in rape cases.
Citizen portal for reporting cyber harassment, morphing, financial fraud, and CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material).
NGRS / National Helpline for Prevention of Atrocities (14566)
24/7 web-linked toll-free helpline providing immediate grievance escalation under the POA and PCR Acts.

Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
Monitoring portal for priority infrastructure and social impact projects across all 8 North Eastern states.
Multi-sectoral awareness and enforcement against female feticide; promotes girl-child education.
Nationwide public campaign auditing and retrofitting public spaces for barrier-free physical and digital access.
Bi-annual mass nutrition sensitization campaign (September & March) driven at the village and Anganwadi level.
Grassroots development campaign saturating infrastructure and reverse-migration incentives in Northern border villages.
Mass community-mobilization campaign across high-vulnerability districts targeting youth and educational institutions.
Prescribes penalties for enforcing religious and social disabilities arising from untouchability.
SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Amended 2018)
Explicit list of atrocities; no anticipatory bail; Section 18A removes requirement of preliminary inquiry or prior sanction before arrest.
Gram Sabha authority over natural resources, minor forest produce, dispute resolution, and project approvals in Schedule V areas.
Recognizes individual and community forest rights (IFR/CFR) for forest-dwelling STs and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (OTFD).
Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation Act, 2013
Complete prohibition of hazardous manual cleaning of sewer/septic tanks; mandates mechanization and alternative livelihood rehabilitation.
Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016
Recognizes 21 categories of disabilities; mandates 4% reservation in government jobs and 5% in higher education for benchmark disabilities; penalizes discrimination.
Legal guardianship and welfare provisions for Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation, and Multiple Disabilities.
Commissions for Protection of Child Rights (CPCR) Act, 2005
Established NCPCR and SCPCRs as statutory watchdogs for children's legal and constitutional rights.
Enforces Article 21A; free and compulsory education (ages 6–14); mandates 25% reservation for disadvantaged groups in private unaided schools.
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 (Amended 2019)
Stringent punishments, including capital punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault; child-friendly special courts; mandatory reporting.
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 (Amended 2021)
DMs/ADMs empowered to issue adoption orders; allows trial of juveniles aged 16–18 as adults for heinous offenses.
Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 (Amended 2016)
Complete ban on employing children below 14 in all occupations; regulates adolescents (14–18) working in hazardous conditions.
Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
Civil law remedy providing protection orders, residence rights, and maintenance through Protection Officers.
Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (POSH) Act, 2013
Mandates Internal Complaints Committees (ICC) in workplaces with ≥ 10 employees and Local Committees (LC) at the district level.
Paid maternity leave enhanced from 12 to 26 weeks; mandatory crèche facility for establishments with 50+ employees.
Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (PCPNDT) Act, 1994
Strict prohibition on sex determination; regulates ultrasound clinics to arrest skewed child sex ratios.
Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
Declares instant Talaq-e-Biddat void and illegal; criminal offense with imprisonment up to 3 years.
Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam)
33% reservation for women in Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and NCT of Delhi.
Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
Legal obligation on adult children/heirs to provide maintenance; establishes Maintenance Tribunals.
Civil, secular marriage framework irrespective of caste, religion, or faith; requires public notification.
Statutory codified personal laws covering conditions of marriage, divorce, and restitution of conjugal rights.
Defines marriageable age (18 for females, 21 for males); child marriages voidable at child's option.
Replaced the IPC; features dedicated chapters prioritizing offenses against women and children, defines organized crime, and penalizes mob lynching.
Replaced the CrPC; integrates timelines for charge sheets, mandatory video recording of search/seizure, and statutory Zero FIR.
National security framework addressing disruptive activities, unlawful associations, and terror funding.
Prohibits the use of religious premises for political activities or harboring criminals/arms.
Freezes the religious character of places of worship as they existed on August 15, 1947 (with specific statutory exceptions).
Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024
Curbs paper leaks and organized cheating in central competitive exams; non-bailable offense with severe fines and imprisonment.
First to use social and educational criteria to identify backward classes; recommended caste-based census and reservations.
Identified 3,743 backward castes; formulated 11 social, educational, and economic indicators; recommended 27% reservation for OBCs.
Examined sub-categorization within OBCs in the Central List to ensure equitable distribution of reservation benefits among underrepresented groups.
Provided the foundation for the PESA Act, 1996, recommending constitutional recognition of traditional Gram Sabhas in Schedule V areas.
Comprehensive evaluation of socio-economic, health, and educational status of tribal communities; recommended preventing tribal land alienation and strictly enforcing the FRA, 2006.
Formulated the classic 5 criteria for ST scheduling: primitive traits, distinct culture, geographical isolation, shyness of contact, and backwardness.
Surveyed De-Notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNTs); led directly to the formulation of the SEED Scheme.
Examining the legal feasibility of according SC status to Dalits who converted to religions other than Hinduism, Sikhism, and Buddhism.
Formed to explore equitable administrative mechanisms and alternative interventions for the most backward sub-castes among SCs (e.g., Madigas).
Assessed the socio-economic and educational status of the Muslim community in India; highlighted severe under-representation in public employment and higher education.
National Commission for Religious and Linguistic Minorities (NCRLM); recommended 15% reservation for minorities (10% for Muslims) in education and government jobs.
Drafted the initial replacement bill for the PwD Act, 1995, aligning India's domestic legal architecture with the UNCRPD (culminating in the RPwD Act, 2016).
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Recommended raising the legal minimum age of marriage for women from 18 to 21 years to lower MMR/IMR and boost female higher education.
Fast-track recommendations post-2012 Nirbhaya incident; expanded rape definitions, introduced stalking and voyeurism offenses, and shaped the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013.
Watershed report uncovering deep gender inequalities, declining sex ratios, and poor health metrics; laid the modern foundation for women-centric planning in India.
Ministry of Women and Child Development
High-Level Committee on the Status of Women; recommended 50% reservation for women in local bodies, gender budgeting institutionalization, and a National Policy for Women.

Landmark committee that recognized child labour is directly tied to poverty; recommended a dual approach of banning hazardous child labor while regulating other forms (led to the 1986 Child Labour Act).
Framed guidelines streamlining adoption processes and oversight on childcare institutions (CCIs) under the Juvenile Justice framework.
